question: With HF_TOKEN provisioned and WebGym 292k/127k manifests, can a sampled diverse census on WebGym 300k deliver >=50 eTLD+1 distinct sites (tldextract 5.3.2 family-level grouping) with family-level B=2000 bootstrap 95% percentile CIs (width>0 non-degenerate), threshold sweeps at 0.818 and 0.900 versus vacuous duplication 0.9479 (range>=0.05 monotonic, delta>=0.20 vs truncated [:20] baseline), parameterization prevalence 0.8958 +-0.05 with byte-identical manifest SHA verification, Jaccard<0.30 product-subtree anchored orthogonality, without exhaustive 567MB LFS test.zip/CAP 420 enumeration, and publish a shared manifest (deterministic sampling, product-subtree anchoring 1280x720) for Physics/Frontier/Product BrowserGym heterogeneous reuse — validating non-degenerate CIs and representation non-vacuity?
hypothesis: H_SAMPLED_CENSUS_REPLACES_EXHAUSTIVE: A HF_TOKEN-provisioned sampled census from WebGym 292k tasks / 127k sites manifests plus pinned WebArena-Verified v2 812 jointly replaces exhaustive 567MB LFS enumeration. Specifically: (i) sampled slice yields >=50 distinct eTLD+1 sites via tldextract/publicsuffix (family-level grouping preserved, documented); (ii) duplication prevalence on diverse slice has family-level bootstrap B=2000 95% percentile CI with width>0 non-degenerate (variance>0, degenerate [0,0]/[1,1] flagged not counted) distinct from vacuous single-store 0.9479 baseline; (iii) threshold sweep at Jaccard/template similarity exactly 0.818 and 0.900 and 0.9479 on same diverse set is monotonic decreasing (prev@0.818 >= prev@0.900 >= prev@0.9479) with range = prev(0.818)-prev(0.9479) >=0.05 and prev(0.900)-prev(0.9479) >=0.02, proving diversity non-vacuous; (iv) parameterization prevalence = 0.8958 +-0.05 (param_slots/total_candidate_fields, documented field_definition) with byte-identical manifest SHA verification (WebArena SHA d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 927596 bytes byte-identical x2, WebGym manifests 64-hex logged x2, Docker Hub am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb 64-hex); (v) pairwise Jaccard of product-subtree token sets across sampled diverse families <0.30 (frozen product-subtree anchored: heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo node_count>1) proving orthogonality vs synthetic 36-family fixtures; (vi) union of WebArena 812 families_ge3 plus sampled WebGym families yields >=10 distinct product families constructible under identical frozen protocol: deterministic random.Random(35725763380).sample(sorted families_ge3,10) executed TWICE with seed reset S1==S2 logged on EACH census, get_task_start_url __SHOPPING__ expansion, product-subtree anchoring node_count>1, distinct outerHTML SHA256 with <body[^>]*>.*?</body> DOTALL + 9 base + expanded {form_key,uenc,store,session,nonce,fotorama\d{6,},timestamp} stripping via page.evaluate recomputed after page.content()+Accessibility.getFullAXTree, SHA before==after TRUE and after mutation !=TRUE at 1280x720 CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree median AX>10 DOM>=2000 on canonical 136/145/196/222 12 captures; (vii) full-tree multi-anchor AX_consistency delta vs truncated [:20] >=0.20 real (shuffled <0.05) validating representation non-vacuity; (viii) shared manifest JSON (deterministic sampling, product-subtree anchoring 1280x720, manifest SHAs, eTLD+1 list, family histogram, B=2000 CIs, sweep tables, Jaccard matrix, constructibility S1/S2) published with path+sha256 in provenance for heterogeneous reuse without exhaustive enumeration.
falsifier: H falsified if after >=2 genuine attempts per durable source (HF_TOKEN-authenticated fetch for WebGym 292k + 127k site manifests and WebArena-Verified v2 812 via GitHub raw, plus GHCR BrowserGym 0.14.3 and Docker Hub am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945..., each timeout>=300s or docker load fallback with URL/HTTP status/bytes/sha256 hex/64-char digest logged, HF_TOKEN present true/false logged, 401/404 captured, stderr/stdout in artifacts) any primary gate fails: (A) sampled diverse eTLD+1 <50, or family-level B=2000 bootstrap 95% CI not computed or degenerate width==0 (variance 0 flagged per prior audits), or threshold sweep at 0.818/0.900/0.9479 not computable / not monotonic decreasing / range 0.818-0.9479 <0.05 or 0.900-0.9479 <0.02, or parameterization prevalence outside 0.8958 +-0.05 or manifest byte-identity fails (WebArena SHA != d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 or Docker digest mismatch), or pairwise Jaccard >=0.30 on any diverse pair violating orthogonality, or full-tree delta vs truncated <0.20 real or shuffled >=0.05, OR (B) union constructible product families <10 distinct with anchoring true + SHA both-directions TRUE and CDP 1280x720 median AX>10/DOM>=2000 fails on canonical 136/145/196/222 12 captures, or shared manifest not published with deterministic sampling + anchoring + SHA provenance. Single-module fail => MIXED, all fail => FALSIFIED, all pass => SURVIVES. No inference if MEASUREMENT_INVALID gating fails. When HF_TOKEN absent after 2 genuine 401/404 attempts, duplication/threshold/sweep clause is UNAVAILABLE (not falsified) but overall H still requires (B) >=10 + Jaccard + delta + shared manifest to SURVIVE; vacuous duplication 0.9479 alone does not satisfy (A).

decision_rule: Frozen three-way after MEASUREMENT_INVALID check: (A) MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any mandatory MV1-MV3/MV5-MV9 gating fails: <2 genuine attempts per required durable source (HF WebGym 292k/127k, HF WebArena 812, GHCR, Docker Hub), missing 64-char digest or manifest SHA d652756608..., pip freeze empty or version/viewport mismatch (0.14.3/0.4.2/1.63.0 1280x720), fallback AX snapshot used, body regex absent, deterministic sampling not executed exactly as specified on BOTH primary (812) and sampled WebGym diverse census, family-level B=2000 bootstrap not trajectory-grouped, Jaccard<0.30 matrix not logged on diverse families, shared manifest not published with deterministic sampling + anchoring + SHA provenance, or provenance missing. MV4 sweep clause alone does not trigger INVALID when HF_TOKEN absent after 2 genuine 401/404 attempts but is marked UNAVAILABLE (PC-B UNAVAILABLE). (B) SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff A passes (MV4 either PASS or documented UNAVAILABLE with at least sampled diverse >=50 and Jaccard<0.30 either PASS or UNAVAILABLE when HF fails) AND H_A_SURVIVES: (SRC_GHCR_SUCCESS OR SRC_DOCKER_SUCCESS) with byte-identical WebArena SHA, sampled diverse >=50 distinct eTLD+1 with B=2000 CI width>0 non-degenerate and when HF succeeds sweep 0.818-0.9479 range>=0.05 and 0.900-0.9479 >=0.02 monotonic and Jaccard<0.30 pairwise orthogonal, parameterization prevalence 0.8958 +-0.05 with byte-identity, full-tree delta vs truncated >=0.20 real shuffled <0.05, AND union constructibility >=10 distinct product families anchoring true SHA both directions TRUE at 1280x720 CDP median AX>10 & DOM>=2000 on canonical 136/145/196/222, plus shared manifest published with path+sha256. (C) Otherwise if A passes but not all B: FALSIFIED if union still <=4 families (bounded ceiling on attempted censuses) and diverse <50 or sweep range<0.05 or Jaccard>=0.30; MIXED if any module passes (e.g., diverse >=50 + sweep + Jaccard passes but constructibility 4/10, or diverse UNAVAILABLE but constructibility >=10 with Jaccard UNAVAILABLE). Audit may bound ceiling narrower than SURVIVES.
